candidate.derivedAnswer: B. It rises from left to right.
candidate.answerReason: The tangent slope is f'(x₀)>0, so the tangent line rises as x increases.

methods.label: Interpret the slope's sign
methods.explanation: The slope is positive, so the tangent line rises.
methods.levelReason: This combines the geometric meaning of the derivative with the elementary direction of a positive-slope line.
